what:
## tools/v2/hot_lint.py doesn't see salsa (from speed-salsa)

- What: `HOT` names crates under `crates/` only, so `vendor/salsa`, `vendor/salsa-macros` and
  `vendor/salsa-macro-rules` (every query's hit path) are never linted. Let `crates` take a path
  relative to the root (or add a `vendor` list) and add the three to `HOT`. The lint also skips
  only a literal `#[cfg(test)]`, so `#[cfg(all(test, ...))]` modules are linted as code.
- Where: `tools/v2/hot_lint.py`.
- Why: speed-salsa linted them by calling `hot_lint.lint_file` on each file directly: 0 findings
  now (fixed, or justified on the line), including the proc macros' expansion-time code.
- Also, for `Cargo.lock` at the first build: `vendor/salsa` now depends on `blaze-mem` (memo
  columns are blaze-mem regions) and dev-depends on `blaze-alloc-count`, both by path; salsa's
  lock entry gains the two.

> forwarded to the coordinator: `tools/` is its; on requests' coordinator list (vendor salsa in `HOT`, `cfg(all(test, ..))` as test code).

history.note: tools/v2/hot_lint.py: Input.crates is tuple[str, ...] (any name under crates/ or a path from the root; a missing crate or a run reading no file exits 2); a test cfg is any predicate only test/fuzz builds set (test, all(test, ..), any(test, feature = "fuzz"), fuzzing); files of out-of-line #[cfg(test)] mod x; (and their submodule dirs) and #[path] sources from tests/ are skipped, as is a file under #![cfg(test)]; comments and string/raw-string/char literals are blanked over the whole file (multi-line too) before both the brace count and the checks; \bvec!\[ so smallvec! is not a fresh Vec; HOT gains vendor/salsa, vendor/salsa-macros, vendor/salsa-macro-rules and fuzz (fuzz/targets stays unread, as tests are), blaze-diagnostics was already in; blaze-tier (no such crate) dropped. The salsa Cargo.lock entry (blaze-mem, blaze-alloc-count) is for the first build's lock refresh; vendor/salsa/src/graph/order.rs now has 19 real findings for its owner.
